title: Quarter Volume Library Prep Step 1: Enzymatic Fragmentation and End Prep
author: Opentrons
materials: The protocol will alert the user to ensure reagents in sufficient volume are present on deck.

steps.title: Pre‑cool Temperature Module
steps.instruction: Set the Temperature Module to 4 °C using the OT app before starting the protocol.

steps.title: Verify reagent volumes
steps.instruction: Check that all reagents on the deck have sufficient volume; the protocol will prompt you to confirm this.

steps.title: Prepare fragmentation master mix
steps.instruction: Create the fragmentation master mix in the designated mix tube using the P300 multi‑channel pipette.

substeps.instruction: Use the P300 multi‑channel with a single tip on the rear‑most channel to dispense the reaction buffer into the mix tube.
Dispense the enzyme mix into the same tube.
Aspirate the resulting fragmentation master mix and dispense it into the first column of the reagent plate.

steps.title: Dispense master mix to samples
steps.instruction: Distribute the fragmentation master mix from the reagent plate to each sample well in the library‑prep plate using the P20 multi‑channel pipette.

substeps.instruction: Select the first column of the reagent plate as the source.
Using the P20 multi‑channel, deliver the fragmentation master mix to every well of the library‑prep plate.
